source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules revision 1.4 (Sigil magic; docs/design/sigil-1.4-proposal.md and decision 98) Rules 1.20 (the heal and shield pass): MEND 10, WARD 12, both growing with the caster's level.

needs.other_means: any word that isn't a Subject

shape.group: A Line is one stroke: glyphs drawn one after another in a straight row. Glyphs from different strokes never join into one Line, even when they touch.

stroke.extends: A new glyph joins a stroke when it is drawn next to the stroke's last glyph and carries on in the same direction, and the stroke has fewer than 4 glyphs. A single glyph can be extended in any of the 8 directions.
stroke.otherwise: Any other glyph starts a new stroke, even if it touches other glyphs.
stroke.picker_default: When a new glyph could join more than one stroke, it joins the one that holds your most recent glyph. If none of them is yours, it starts a new Line; it joins an ally's stroke only when you pick that stroke yourself.
stroke.stack: A second glyph on a tile joins the stroke of the glyph already there.
stroke.split: Removing a glyph from the middle of a stroke splits it in two.

junction.text: With Brain Power Mastered, one glyph can belong to two strokes where they cross: it extends two strokes at once, or extends one and starts a new one. It counts as a word of whichever Line is Evoked, and it fades when the second Line is Evoked.

draw.cost: Drawing a glyph costs the word's charge, your Glyph AP and 1 Flux (2 Flux for TWICE).
draw.two_glyph_hook: A perk, trait or skill can let you put a second glyph on a tile; so far only the Stroke Gambler's half-glyphs do. Two glyphs alone on one tile are a Stack.

evoke.stand: Stand within 1 tile of any glyph of the Line, but not on a middle glyph.

facing.along: Stand on an end glyph, or next to an end and further along the Line than it, to fire along the Line. The area runs out past the far end and is as many tiles wide as the Line has glyphs, centred on the Line; with an even number, the extra tile is on the right of the firing direction.
facing.across: Stand beside the Line to fire across it. The area runs straight away from you, one lane for each glyph. For a diagonal Line it runs straight north, south, east or west, whichever leads away from you; when two do, it runs north or south.
facing.width: The area is as wide as the whole Line: one lane for each glyph.
facing.depth: The area is as deep as the Reach word's range plus your range bonus, or 1 tile with no Reach word (Touch).
facing.finished_line: You finish a Line standing on its last glyph, so a finished Line fires back the way you walked. The preview shows the area before you confirm.
facing.stack: A Stack fires all around itself, out to its range, at whatever it can see. Only a caster who can put two glyphs on one tile can make one.

grammar.self_target: You can always target your own tile, whatever the Reach. PUSH can't land there, and QUICKEN doesn't affect you.
grammar.range_bonus: Half your Brain Power, rounded down, plus any perks. It is added once to a Reach word's range, and never to Touch.

repeats.subjects: Repeated Subjects add their damage, healing and shields together. Each copy's extra effect still applies only once.

line_mult.who: characters and the units that fight for them; an enemy caster's damage comes from the enemy table
line_mult.text: A Line's direct damage is multiplied by its length: ×1.7 for 2 glyphs, ×1.75 for 3, ×1.8 for 4. Healing, shields, ranges and conditions are not changed.

critical.text: A natural 20 on a spell's roll to hit is a critical: ×1.5 damage, up to ×2.0 with everything on your sheet and gear, the same rule as a weapon's critical.

elite_guard.text: One Evoke never takes an Elite or a Boss of your level or higher from full HP to nothing: it is left on 1 HP.

refused.why: WATCH and STAY can't be in the same spell: a turret already lasts.
A spell can have only one Reach word.
A spell can hold only one KIN.
PUSH can't land on your own tile: a cone needs a direction.

grammar.multipliers: A spell's strength is its Subjects added together, × the Reach word, × the Burst word, × the Delivery word (×0.5 for a field or turret, ×0.75 for each CHAIN jump), × 0.9 for each repeated glyph, × your Sigil multiplier. Damage is also × the Line multiplier (×1.7 for 2 glyphs, ×1.75 for 3, ×1.8 for 4). Elemental damage is also × your Elemental multiplier, MEND and WARD are also × your Healing given, and a critical hit is ×1.5 damage (up to ×2.0). Armour comes off last.

mixes.condense+spread: CONDENSE with SPREAD: ×1.5 on the tile where the spell lands and ×0.6 around it.
mixes.condense+push: CONDENSE with PUSH: ×1.5 on the tile where the spell lands and ×0.7 in the cone.
mixes.spread+push: SPREAD with PUSH: the spell covers both the radius and the cone. Anyone in both is hit once, at the better multiplier.
mixes.stay+pull: STAY with PULL: a whirlpool. Each round the field drags everyone in it toward you.
mixes.wait+watch: WAIT with WATCH: a hidden turret.
mixes.watch+chain: WATCH with CHAIN: a turret whose shots jump from target to target.

grammar.workings_with_burst: With a Burst word, RAISE and NULL cover the Burst's tiles. VEIL and LIGHT cover their own radius or the Burst's, whichever is larger. STEP moves everyone it catches the same distance in the same direction.
grammar.fizzle: A spell that goes off but finds nothing it can affect fizzles: nothing happens, the charge, AP and Flux are still spent, and its glyphs fade.
grammar.skips: Harmful effects skip Downed and surrendered creatures. Boons still reach them.

retired.migrate: drop it; one free word of the player's choice at the next rest

retired.why: The Line is the only shape.
Two glyphs on one tile need the two-glyph hook.

study.text: Every Evoke earns study: 1, +1 for each glyph past the second, and +1 if the spell hit an enemy. A fizzle earns none. At 6 study, and every 8 after that, you can learn a new word of your choice, up to the number of words you can know; a pick you have no room for waits until you do. Copying a word you don't know earns 2 study and adds it to your list of words to study, once for each glyph: read the glyph, read the trace a scuffed glyph leaves for 2 rounds, or Analyze the enemy that drew it. Each Mastery level in Brain Power, Rumination or Eloquence gives 5 study, and Mastering one of them gives a free word that doesn't count against your limit.

word_mastery.text: Each Evoke adds 1 use to every word in the spell that you know, however many copies of it the spell holds. A word is Practised at 10 uses and Mastered at 30. A Mastered word's inflection is always on for you.

fire.rider: A critical hit sets the target Burning.
fire.look: A white-hot core flaring orange at the edges, embers lifting off the tile, a scorch left for a beat.

freeze.rider: The target is Slowed unless it passes a Body save.
freeze.look: Pale blue-white frost spreading in sharp crystals from the impact, a breath of mist, the target rimed.
freeze.sound: A glassy crack and a high ring.

shock.look: A jagged blue-white arc with branches, a hard flicker of the tile, a jump between targets for CHAIN.
shock.sound: A sharp snap and electric buzz.

stone.rider: Sigil damage: armour counts in full.
stone.look: Grey-brown shards and dust bursting up from the ground, a short heavy shake.
stone.sound: A deep thud and grinding crunch.

gale.look: Pale curved streaks sweeping through, dust and debris swept along the push.

spark.rider: No extra effect. It is the cheapest attack.
spark.look: A small bright pinpoint flash and a few scattered sparks.

acid.rider: The target is Corroded: 5 damage a turn and −2 Defense for 3 rounds. A Body save at the end of its turn ends it early.
acid.look: Sickly yellow-green droplets that hiss and pit the target, a thin smoke while it burns.
acid.sound: A wet splash, then a long hiss.

enemy_ai.text: Enemies with an Evoker know their stat block's words, or their tier's default set. They weigh a spell against their weapon by expected damage, walk the Line on their own tiles, avoid hitting their own side (KIN, or target choice), hold a spell that would hit more allies than enemies, set traps where players will cross, and NULL or scuff the player magic they have spotted when it threatens them.

notes: Rules 1.4: 40 words in five groups (group + class). Subjects carry their effect fields; Reach, Delivery and Burst words carry their numbers and per_copy (what each extra copy adds); every repeated glyph also multiplies the spell's damage, healing and shields by grammar.repeats.mult_per_repeated_glyph. grand is the Grand Sigilist's Grand form (the 23 words kept from 1.2). Every number is provisional. Rules 1.17: line_mult (a Line's damage by its length), critical ×1.5 to ×2.0, no ceiling on a spell's damage, the Elite and Boss guard.

items.name: Fire
items.text: Deals 30 Elemental damage. On a critical hit the target starts Burning.
items.grand: Lava floor. Anyone who enters the area or starts a turn in it takes 10 fire damage, and starts Burning unless they pass a Body save.

inflection.text: When FIRE's Burning is put out, it keeps burning for 1 more round.

items.name: Freeze
items.text: Deals 25 Elemental damage. The target is Slowed unless it passes a Body save.
items.grand: Ice sheet. The area is difficult ground, and anyone who moves through it must pass a Body save or fall Prone.

inflection.text: Slowed from FREEZE lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Shock
items.text: Deals 30 Elemental damage. It ignores half cover.
items.grand: Storm field. Anyone wearing Medium armour or heavier who starts a turn in the area takes 15 lightning damage, and robots that start a turn there are Stunned for 1 round.

inflection.text: A spell with SHOCK in it has +1 to hit.

items.name: Stone
items.text: Deals 35 Sigil damage. Armour counts in full against it.
items.grand: Earthworks. Up to 4 pillars rise in the area, on the tiles you choose. Each one is half cover.

inflection.text: STONE deals 10% more damage.

items.name: Gale
items.text: Deals 15 Sigil damage and pushes the target 2 tiles away from where the spell came from.
items.grand: Cyclone. Anyone who enters the area is pushed 2 tiles outward, and shots that pass through it have −5 to hit.

inflection.text: GALE pushes the target 1 tile further.

items.name: Spark
items.text: Deals 15 Elemental damage. It is the cheapest attack word.
items.grand: Static. An attack made from inside the area jams the attacker's weapon if the die shows 1, 2 or 3.

inflection.text: SPARK deals 10% more damage.

items.name: Acid
items.text: Deals 15 Elemental damage and leaves the target Corroded, with no save: 5 damage at the start of each of its turns and −2 Defense, for 3 rounds. A Body save at the end of each of its turns ends it early.
items.grand: Etching ground. At the start of each round, cover in the area (crates, barrels, low walls, pillars, barricades and Sigil walls) loses 15 HP and crumbles at 0. Your side has +2 to hit enemies standing in the area.

inflection.text: Corroded from ACID lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Bind
items.text: The target is Pinned unless it passes a Body save.
items.grand: Tar. Anyone who enters the area must pass a Body save or be Pinned and stop where they are.

inflection.text: The Body save against BIND is 1 harder.

items.name: Blind
items.text: The target is Blinded unless it passes a Body save.
items.grand: Fog. Nobody inside the area can see further than 1 tile.

inflection.text: Blinded from BLIND lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Slow
items.text: The target is Slowed unless it passes a Body save. It deals no damage.
items.grand: Mire. Movement is halved inside the area.

inflection.text: The Body save against SLOW is 1 harder.

items.name: Muddle
items.text: The target gets a Left Brain Debuff unless it passes a Brain save.
items.grand: Maze. Anyone who starts a turn in the area must pass a Brain save or stagger 1 tile in a random direction.

inflection.text: The Left Brain Debuff from MUDDLE lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Dread
items.text: The target is Shaken unless it passes a Heart save.
items.grand: Haunting. Each enemy that starts a turn in the area is Shaken unless it passes a Heart save.

inflection.text: Shaken from DREAD lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Silence
items.text: The target is Silenced for 1 round unless it passes a Brain save: it can't use Sigils, Outbursts or prayers.
items.grand: Dead zone. Nobody inside the area can use Sigils, Outbursts or prayers, you included.

inflection.text: The Brain save against SILENCE is 1 harder.

items.name: Command
items.text: The target must pass a Brain save or obey one order on its next turn: halt, kneel, drop its weapon, or move up to 3 tiles to a place you choose. An order can never send it into harm.
items.grand: Parade ground. Each enemy that starts a turn in the area must pass a Brain save or halt: it is Pinned for that turn, so it can't move but can still act.

inflection.text: A move order from COMMAND can send the target 1 tile further.

items.name: Ward
items.text: The target gains a shield of 12 × your Sigil multiplier × your Healing given, until the end of the fight. It grows with your level, like healing. Shields don't add up: the bigger one stays.
items.grand: Dome. Each ally who starts a turn in the area gets +2 Defense and a shield of 20. The shield doesn't add to one they already have.

inflection.text: WARD's shield is 10% bigger.

items.name: Mend
items.text: Heals the target for 10 × your Sigil multiplier × your Healing given. It grows with your level (×1.13 at level 6, ×1.38 at level 12, ×1.82 at level 20).
items.grand: Spring. Each ally who starts a turn in the area heals 10 × your Healing given.

inflection.text: MEND heals 10% more.

items.name: Quicken
items.text: The target is Quickened: +2 AP on its next turn, up to the limit of 9 AP. It never works on you, and each target can be Quickened only once a round.
items.grand: Quickstep. Each ally other than you who starts a turn in the area gets +1 AP that turn, up to the limit of 9 AP.

inflection.text: QUICKEN costs 1 less charge to draw.

items.name: Sharpen
items.text: The target is Sharpened: its next attack has +3 to hit and deals ×1.25 damage. It lasts until that attack or the end of the target's next turn.
items.grand: Whetstone. Weapon attacks your side makes from inside the area deal +5 damage, or +10 with melee and unarmed attacks. This includes your own.

inflection.text: SHARPEN costs 1 less charge to draw.

items.name: Cleanse
items.text: Ends one harmful condition on the target, the newest first.
items.grand: Clear water. Each ally who starts a turn in the area loses their newest harmful condition.

inflection.text: CLEANSE costs 1 less charge to draw.

items.name: Veil
items.text: Smoke fills every tile within 1 of the target and blocks sight. It lasts 2 rounds plus your Sigil duration bonus.
items.grand: Smoke field. The area blocks all sight, and everyone inside counts as Hidden.

inflection.text: VEIL's smoke lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Light
items.text: Lights every tile within 4 of the target for the rest of the scene and reveals anyone Hidden there.
items.grand: Noon. Hidden enemies in the area are revealed, and enemies inside have −2 to hit.

inflection.text: LIGHT reaches 1 tile further.

items.name: Step
items.text: Teleports whoever the spell affects to a free tile you pick, up to 4 tiles from where they stand, past anything in between. An enemy can resist with a Body save. Cast on yourself, it is a blink.
items.grand: Fold. Any move your side makes that starts and stays inside the area costs 1 AP at most, however far it goes.

inflection.text: STEP teleports 1 tile further.

items.name: Raise
items.text: A solid wall rises on each empty tile the spell covers. A wall blocks movement and sight, has 30 HP and lasts 3 rounds plus your Sigil duration bonus. You can keep only one RAISE spell's walls standing: new walls replace the old ones.
items.grand: Ramparts. Up to 8 walls rise around the edge of the area, on every other edge tile and never on a creature. Each is solid with 30 HP, and they fall when the Grand form ends.

inflection.text: RAISE's walls have 10% more HP.

items.name: Null
items.text: Dispels the Sigil magic placed on the tiles the spell covers: anyone's glyphs, fields, traps and turrets, and the smoke, light and walls of other spells. Keystones, Grand forms and class zones stay.
items.grand: Clean ground. Sigil magic placed in the area (glyphs, fields, traps, turrets, smoke, light and walls, but not Keystones) is wiped when the Grand form goes up and again at the start of each round. Nobody can draw a glyph inside, you included.

inflection.text: NULL costs 1 less charge to draw.

items.name: Mask
items.text: The target becomes Hidden until it attacks, or for 2 rounds. It does nothing to a Marked target.
items.grand: Hall of masks. Enemies outside the area can't target your side inside it from more than 3 tiles away.

inflection.text: Hidden from MASK lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Seek
items.text: A straight bolt with range 8. You must see the target. The first creature in its path takes the hit, and full cover in its path stops it.
items.grand: Hunting ground. Your side's attacks against enemies in the area ignore half cover.

inflection.text: SEEK has +1 range.

items.name: Arc
items.text: A lob with range 6, at ×0.8 strength. Nothing in its path blocks it, but you must see the tile it lands on.
items.grand: Mortar pit. At the start of each of your turns the staff shells the tile within 6 tiles of it that catches the most enemies: 15 Sigil damage on that tile and 5 to enemies next to it. It can hit outside the area.

inflection.text: ARC has +1 range.

items.name: Sense
items.text: The spell appears at the target: range 8, at ×0.6 strength. You don't need to see the target, and nothing blocks it.
items.grand: Second sight. Hidden enemies within 4 tiles of the staff are revealed at the start of every turn.

inflection.text: SENSE has +1 range.

items.name: Relay
items.text: The spell is cast from an ally's tile, as if you stood there. Pick an ally within 8 tiles that you can see: the spell can hit that ally's tile and the tiles next to it.
items.grand: Relay net. An attack your side makes from inside the area gets +1 to hit for each other ally inside who has a clear line to the target, up to +3.

inflection.text: RELAY reaches an ally 1 tile further away.

items.name: Stay
items.text: A field. The spell hits once at full strength when Evoked, then stays on its tiles for 2 rounds plus your Sigil duration bonus. Anyone who enters the field or starts a turn in it is hit, once a round: at full strength the first time the field affects them (the hit when Evoked counts), at ×0.5 after that.
items.grand: Stasis. Conditions on anyone inside the area don't count down.

inflection.text: STAY's field lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Twice
items.text: Two missiles at two targets you pick, each with its own Burst. Drawing this glyph adds 2 Flux instead of 1.
items.grand: Echo field. Once a round, the first spell your side lands in the area hits again on each enemy it hit, for half its damage per target (at least 5).

inflection.text: Drawing TWICE adds 1 Flux, like any other glyph.

items.name: Pull
items.text: After the hit, each target the spell affected is dragged 3 tiles toward you. A turret's spell drags toward the turret.
items.grand: Vortex. Each enemy within 4 tiles of the staff is pulled 1 tile toward it at the start of its turn.

inflection.text: PULL drags targets 1 tile further.

items.name: Wait
items.text: A trap on the tile you aim at, hidden from the enemy until they spot it. It goes off once, when an enemy steps on it or starts a turn on it; your side never sets it off. It lasts 3 rounds plus your Sigil duration bonus. You can keep 2 traps at a time: a third replaces the oldest.
items.grand: Minefield. The first time each round an enemy enters the area, it takes 10 Sigil damage and stops moving.

inflection.text: WAIT's trap lasts 1 round longer.

items.name: Watch
items.text: A turret on the tile you aim at. At the start of each of your turns it casts the spell at ×0.5 strength at the nearest creature it can reach, allies included. It lasts 2 rounds plus your Sigil duration bonus and has 10 HP; a hit or a Scuff destroys it. You can keep 1 turret at a time: a new one replaces it.
items.grand: Sentinel. At the start of each of your turns the staff hits the nearest enemy in the area for 15 Sigil damage. An enemy that leaves the area takes 10, once a round each.

inflection.text: WATCH's turret has +1 Defense.

items.name: Chain
items.text: After the hit, the spell jumps on to the next creature within 3 tiles that is no closer to you (or to the turret), at ×0.75 of the last hit. It never jumps back to a creature it already hit, nothing blocks a jump, and it can jump to allies.
items.grand: Conductor. When your side damages an enemy in the area, 10 lightning damage arcs to the nearest other enemy inside within 3 tiles. Each enemy can be arced to once a round.

inflection.text: CHAIN jumps 1 tile further.

items.name: Leech
items.text: After the hit, you heal half of all the damage the spell dealt.
items.grand: Bloodwell. Each hit your side lands on an enemy in the area heals the attacker for 5, once a round for each attacker and enemy.

inflection.text: LEECH heals you for 55% of the damage instead of half.

items.name: Condense
items.text: One target, at ×1.5 strength.
items.grand: Crush. Each enemy that starts a turn in the area next to another creature takes 10 Sigil damage.

inflection.text: CONDENSE is ×1.6 instead of ×1.5.

items.name: Spread
items.text: Hits everyone within 2 tiles of where the spell lands (a 5 × 5 area), at ×0.6 strength. It can land on empty ground.
items.grand: Bloom. When your side lands a spell in the area, every enemy inside that the spell didn't hit takes 10 Sigil damage.

inflection.text: In a 4-glyph spell, SPREAD reaches 1 tile further.

items.name: Push
items.text: A widening cone 3 tiles long, at ×0.7 strength. It starts where the spell lands and carries on in the direction the spell was travelling. It can land on empty ground, but never on your own tile.
items.grand: Gust. Each enemy that starts a turn in the area is blown 1 tile outward, away from the staff.

inflection.text: PUSH's cone is 1 tile longer.

items.name: Kin
items.text: The spell never affects your side. You can't aim it at an ally, and nothing in it touches you or your allies; your own tile is the one place on your side you can still aim, and KIN spares you there. Keep it out of healing and shielding spells: it skips your allies there too. It changes who the spell affects, not where it goes.
items.grand: Sanctum. Allies inside the area take no damage from your side's spells and attacks.

inflection.text: KIN also spares Downed and surrendered enemies.
